task: forecast future COT maps from retrieved historical COT maps

model.spatial_encoder: shared per-frame CNN with stride-8 latent map
model.historical_temporal_operator: Conv3d on the 8 observed latent frames only
model.future_geometry: known deterministic geometry encoder added per lead
model.decoder: shared per-lead CNN to full-resolution COT map
model.initialization: random; no old checkpoint warm start

primary_reference_metric: CPP physical-COT RMSE on fixed common support
regional_shape: not frozen until the selected R native grid and bank support are verified

engineering_smoke.scope_limit: single synthetic batch; not COT accuracy, real-data validation, throughput profile, or training

data_gate.new_monthly_R: not available as a completed checkpoint
data_gate.blocker: date-safe new-split R and train/validation retrieved-COT frame bank required
